tools.description: Test .gitignore or glob patterns against a list of paths and see which rule matched each one. Operations: "test" — Match paths against gitignore rules (negation, anchoring, **, directory-only) or plain globs.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: test — Match paths against gitignore rules (negation, anchoring, **, directory-only) or plain globs.

input.description: Paths to test, one per line; end a directory with / (e.g. build/ or src/app.js).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

patterns.description: The patterns, one per line, as in a .gitignore file. Used by: test. Required by: test.

mode.description: gitignore: git’s rules (last match wins, excluded parents stay excluded); glob: each pattern against the whole path, with {a,b}. Used by: test.

tools.name: punycode
tools.description: Convert internationalised domain names to and from Punycode (RFC 3492): bücher.example ⇄ xn--bcher-kva.example. Operations: "to-ascii" — Encode each Unicode label as an xn-- label (one domain, email or URL per line; labels are NFC-normalised and lowercased).; "to-unicode" — Decode each xn-- label back to Unicode (one domain, email or URL per line).; "encode" — Encode one string with the bare RFC 3492 algorithm (no xn-- prefix, case kept).; "decode" — Decode one bare Punycode string (no xn-- prefix) with the RFC 3492 algorithm.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: to-ascii — Encode each Unicode label as an xn-- label (one domain, email or URL per line; labels are NFC-normalised and lowercased). to-unicode — Decode each xn-- label back to Unicode (one domain, email or URL per line). encode — Encode one string with the bare RFC 3492 algorithm (no xn-- prefix, case kept). decode — Decode one bare Punycode string (no xn-- prefix) with the RFC 3492 algorithm.

input.description: to-ascii: Domain names, email addresses or URLs, one per line. to-unicode: Domain names, email addresses or URLs with xn-- labels, one per line. encode: The Unicode string to encode. decode: The Punycode string to decode.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

tools.name: ieee754
tools.description: Inspect IEEE 754 float32/float64: sign, exponent and mantissa bits, hex, the exact stored value and the rounding error. Operations: "inspect" — Read a decimal (0.1, -2.5e-8, Infinity, NaN) or a bit pattern (0x3DCCCCCD, 32 or 64 binary digits) and show how float32 and float64 store it.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: inspect — Read a decimal (0.1, -2.5e-8, Infinity, NaN) or a bit pattern (0x3DCCCCCD, 32 or 64 binary digits) and show how float32 and float64 store it.

input.description: A decimal number, Infinity/NaN, 0x + 8 or 16 hex digits, or 32/64 bits.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

format.description: Which binary format(s) to show. Used by: inspect.

tools.name: html-markdown
tools.description: Convert HTML to Markdown (CommonMark + GitHub tables), dropping scripts and styles. Operations: "convert" — Convert an HTML page or fragment to Markdown: headings, lists, links, images, code blocks, tables and blockquotes.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: convert — Convert an HTML page or fragment to Markdown: headings, lists, links, images, code blocks, tables and blockquotes.

input.description: The HTML to convert (a whole page or a fragment).

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

scope.description: main: convert only the first <main> (or <article>) when the page has one; all: the whole body. Used by: convert.

baseUrl.description: Absolute URL to resolve relative links and images against. Used by: convert.

images.description: Keep images as ![alt](src); false writes only their alt text. Used by: convert.

tools.name: robots-txt
tools.description: Build robots.txt that treats search engines, AI answer bots and AI training crawlers separately; validate llms.txt. Operations: "build" — Build robots.txt: allow or block search engines, AI answer engines/assistants and AI training crawlers (named), with Content-Signal and Sitemap lines.; "validate-llms" — Check an llms.txt file against llmstxt.org: one H1, a > summary, H2 sections of Markdown link lists.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: build — Build robots.txt: allow or block search engines, AI answer engines/assistants and AI training crawlers (named), with Content-Signal and Sitemap lines. validate-llms — Check an llms.txt file against llmstxt.org: one H1, a > summary, H2 sections of Markdown link lists.

input.description: build: One item per line: sitemap URLs (https://…) and paths every crawler should skip (/admin/). May be empty. validate-llms: The llms.txt file to check.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

search.description: Search engines and every crawler not named (the * group). Used by: build.

aiAnswer.description: AI answer engines and assistants that fetch pages to answer a question. Used by: build.

aiTrain.description: Crawlers that collect text to train AI models. Used by: build.

contentSignal.description: Add contentsignals.org Content-Signal lines matching the choices. Used by: build.

tools.name: compress
tools.description: gzip, deflate (zlib) or raw-deflate text to Base64 or hex, and decompress it back. Operations: "compress" — Compress UTF-8 text with gzip, deflate (zlib) or raw deflate.; "decompress" — Decompress Base64 or hex gzip/deflate data back to text (output up to 256 KB).. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: compress — Compress UTF-8 text with gzip, deflate (zlib) or raw deflate. decompress — Decompress Base64 or hex gzip/deflate data back to text (output up to 256 KB).

input.description: compress: The text to compress. decompress: The compressed bytes, as Base64 or hex.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

algorithm.description: compress: gzip (RFC 1952), deflate = zlib (RFC 1950) or deflate-raw (RFC 1951). decompress: auto reads the format from the first bytes. Used by: compress, decompress.

encoding.description: How the compressed bytes are written. Used by: compress, decompress.

tools.name: saml-decoder
tools.description: Decode a SAMLRequest or SAMLResponse (Base64, or deflate + Base64) and summarise it. Signatures are not verified. Operations: "decode" — Decode a SAML message and return its issuer, status, NameID, audience, conditions, validity window, attributes and pretty-printed XML. Signatures are reported, never verified.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: decode returns a different result on each call.

operation.description: decode — Decode a SAML message and return its issuer, status, NameID, audience, conditions, validity window, attributes and pretty-printed XML. Signatures are reported, never verified.

input.description: The SAMLRequest/SAMLResponse value (Base64 for HTTP-POST, deflate + Base64 for HTTP-Redirect), a URL or form body containing it, or the XML.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

tools.name: key-inspector
tools.description: Inspect a CSR (subject, SANs, key, signature check), OpenSSH public keys (type, bits, ssh-keygen fingerprints) or a JWK / JWKS (RFC 7638 thumbprint, PEM and OpenSSH forms). Private keys are refused. Operations: "inspect" — Inspect a PEM CSR or public key, OpenSSH public key lines (authorized_keys, known_hosts) or a JWK / JWK Set.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: inspect — Inspect a PEM CSR or public key, OpenSSH public key lines (authorized_keys, known_hosts) or a JWK / JWK Set.

input.description: A -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST----- or PUBLIC KEY block, one or more "ssh-ed25519 AAAA…" lines, or JWK JSON.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

tools.name: json-schema-validator
tools.description: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (drafts 2020-12, 2019-09, 7 and 4) and list each error with its data path and schema keyword. Operations: "validate" — Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: validate — Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema.

input.description: The JSON data (instance) to validate.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

schema.description: The JSON Schema, as JSON text. Self-contained: $ref may point inside it ($defs, definitions) but remote schemas are not fetched. Used by: validate. Required by: validate.

draft.description: Schema draft. "auto" reads $schema and falls back to 2020-12. Used by: validate.
